name: Treeblade
body:
Price 6,305 gp; Slot none; CL 7th; Weight 4 lbs.; Aura faint transmutation

This weapon appears as a Large tree trunk complete with branches and leaves, but has the weight and maneuverability of a longsword for its wielder. It can be wielded by anyone proficient with the longsword or scimitar, and can be used with any feat or ability that affects either of these weapons, but deals bludgeoning damage as a Large +1 resizing greatclub.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,152 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells plant growth, wilderness soldiers
